results.name: O1 account-wide 401/20003: 3 shops x 4 customers -> 1 operator email, 1 owner outage email per shop, 12 requests, 1 POST per reply, nothing resent over 26h

operator.subject: Texting is down for every shop: Twilio account-level rejection
operator.text:
Twilio rejected a managed customer text with an account-level error (HTTP 401, code 20003) at 2026-10-22T18:00:02.000Z.
This usually means the Twilio account is suspended or its credentials no longer work, so every shop's texts will fail until it is fixed.
Nothing is resent. Each failed customer reply is marked not delivered and saved as a request in that shop's workspace; each shop's owner gets at most one email per Houston day saying texting is temporarily unavailable.
This is the only alert email for today (2026-10-22). Check Twilio, then the admin portal: https://sms-integration.example.test/admin.html

ownerOutageEmail.subject: Texting is temporarily unavailable: customers did not get replies
ownerOutageEmail.text:
Texting is temporarily unavailable: customers did not get replies
Fixture Service: automatic text replies are not reaching your customers right now because of a problem on our side with our texting provider. We are working on it.
Replies that could not be sent were not sent again. Each customer who did not get a reply is saved as a request in your workspace, with what they wrote. Please call or text them yourself.
This is the only email about this for 2026-10-22. Customers affected later that day are added to your workspace without another email.
Open your workspace to review and respond.
